title: Effect of a threaded-map action
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$, and let $q,q'$ be optional states of the threaded-map controller built over $M$. Let $p$ be an input-head position, $h$ an integer capture-head position, $o$ a Boolean word, $m,d\in\{-1,0,1\}$ be directions, and $b$ an optional Boolean output symbol. Applying the administrative action with input movement $m$, capture-head movement $d$, output symbol $b$, and successor state $q'$ to the threaded-map configuration determined by $c,q,p,h,o$ gives the threaded-map configuration determined by $c,q'$, the input-head position obtained by moving $p$ by $m$, capture-head position $h+d$, and output word $o$ followed by $b$ when present.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
c is a configuration of M on input x
q and q' are optional threaded-map controller states
p is a valid input-head position for x
h is an integer capture-head position
m and d are directions in {-1,0,1}
b is an optional Boolean symbol
replaced:
Applying an administrative action of the threaded-map controller moves the
input position and the capture-head displacement by the specified directions,
installs the designated control state, and appends the optional emission to
the output; no work-tape cell changes.
